jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Maven AGI is an enterprise https://www.mavenagi.com/ AI platform on a mission to unleash business artificial general intelligence (AGI), starting with customer service. Founded in July 2023 by executives from HubSpot, Google and Stripe, Maven builds conversational AI agents capable of delivering accurate, autonomous support that delights customers at scale.



Our platform unifies fragmented systems, integrates knowledge and personalization sources, and enables intelligent actions - all without costly system changes. We’re laying the foundation for a future where our technology handles complex tasks, allowing people to focus on what they do best: creative problem-solving, relationship building, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.



We’ve started by reimagining the enterprise customer experience with a support use case. We believe that today’s support experience is broken: slow and painful for customers, and expensive and human capital intensive for companies.



We are building Maven to deliver better, cheaper support, for both end users and agents. With recent advancements in Generative AI, it is now possible to deliver delightful customer experiences at a fraction of today’s cost.


Team:

Maven has assembled a world-class team from Google, Meta, Amazon, and Stripe, and is supported by executives & Advisors from OpenAI, Google, HubSpot, and Stripe.


Position Overview:

We are hiring a Chief of Staff to the CEO to serve as a strategic partner to our CEO and leadership team as we scale an enterprise AI platform transforming customer support and operations. This role is designed for a highly analytical, execution-oriented leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, operations, and communication.

As Chief of Staff, you will act as a force multiplier for the CEO—driving alignment across the company, owning critical initiatives, and ensuring that Maven AGI executes with speed, clarity, and rigor. You’ll operate across product, go-to-market, engineering, and operations, helping turn company-level priorities into concrete plans and measurable outcomes.

This is a high-impact role with broad exposure to company strategy, executive decision-making, and the challenges of scaling an AI-first enterprise business.



What You’ll Do:



 - Partner closely with the CEO to drive strategic planning, goal-setting, and execution across the company

 - Own and lead cross-functional, high-priority initiatives—from new product bets to operational improvements

 - Act as a connective layer between teams, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, and outcomes

 - Prepare executive briefings, internal communications, and decision memos that distill complex topics clearly

 - Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities early—and proactively drive solutions

 - Improve operating cadence (OKRs, metrics, exec meetings, planning processes) to help the company scale effectively

 - Represent the CEO in meetings when appropriate and follow through to ensure decisions turn into action

Who You Are:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in a high-growth startup, management consulting, investment banking, product operations, or a similarly fast-paced environment

 - Background in venture capital or top-tier management consulting; former VC experience strongly preferred

 - Deep familiarity with investor processes, including financial modeling, data room construction, and fundraising support

 - Proven ability to lead and execute change management initiatives in fast-growing organizations

 - Are a strong strategic thinker who can translate vision into execution, structure, and results

 - Excel at cross-functional collaboration and can influence outcomes without formal authority

 - Thrive in ambiguity and can independently prioritize, execute, and iterate quickly

 - Have exceptional written and verbal communication skills and can synthesize complex ideas with clarity

 - Are highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple high-stakes workstreams at once

 - Are comfortable using data and metrics to drive decisions and measure impact

 - Have led or supported company-wide initiatives involving multiple senior stakeholders

 - Are known for anticipating needs, spotting issues before they escalate, and acting proactively



How you show up:

What unites us is our Values and the passion we share to live by them:

 - We are customer champions. - You put users at the center of your thinking, advocate for their needs, and design solutions that make their lives measurably better.

 - We are bold in action. - You move with urgency and courage. You’re not afraid to challenge convention, take smart risks, and push boundaries in pursuit of meaningful outcomes.

 - We are data-driven and insight guided. - You make thoughtful decisions grounded in evidence. You’re curious, analytical, and combine data with intuition to guide strategy and execution.

 - We are stronger together. - You bring others along, value diverse perspectives, and contribute to a culture of trust and shared ownership. You believe the best ideas emerge through open dialogue and collective effort.

What We Offer:

 - High Impact in cutting-edge field: Be at the vanguard of AI innovation.

 - Compensation Package: Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful equity stakes.

 - Inclusive Culture: A diverse and welcoming work environment where everyone’s voice is heard.



MavenAGI is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and is committed to fostering an environment where everyone feels included.

Join us in changing the face of enterprise customer support.

jobs.title: Director, People Business Partner
jobs.description:
Maven AGI sits at the center of the hottest intersection in tech right now: AI and customer experience. While most "AI support" tools still focus on FAQs and deflection, Maven's agents actually do the work: autonomously interacting with customers, personalizing the conversation, and resolving complex issues, not just providing information. 

That's not a soft ROI story. It's the most direct cost-displacement case in enterprise software today: real human work, replaced, at a fraction of the cost. Not "savings if you use it well," but savings because the agent did the ticket instead of a person.


Founded in 2023 by executives from HubSpot, Google, and Stripe, Maven builds conversational AI agents that don't just answer customers, they act: going into a customer's account, finding the actual problem, and fixing it, with no human required. Customers like Dell, ServPro, HardRock, Tripadvisor, Clio, and Thumbtack rely on Maven, with independently verified results (customers report resolving 70–93% of interactions autonomously) and G2 has named Maven a High Performer and Best Meets Requirements across multiple categories this spring.




POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for a Director, People Business Partner to help build and scale the People function at Maven during a period of significant growth. This is a high-impact, hands-on role for someone who can move seamlessly between partnering with senior leaders on complex People challenges and rolling up their sleeves to build and execute the processes that make a growing company run.

You'll own a broad range of work across the employee lifecycle, including performance management, employee relations, promotions, terminations, policies, compliance, onboarding and offboarding, while helping build the People infrastructure and playbooks Maven needs for its next stage of growth.

Just as importantly, you'll serve as a trusted thought partner to leaders across the company. We're looking for someone who brings strong judgment, intellectual curiosity, and the confidence to challenge assumptions, push back when needed, and help leaders navigate difficult People and organizational decisions.

This is not a traditional HRBP role where you'll advise one function from within a large, established People organization, nor is it a role where strategy happens at the expense of execution. We're looking for a high-agency builder who thrives in fast-moving environments, sees what needs to happen and drives it forward, and is equally energized by strategic partnership and hands-on execution.



*This is a hybrid in-office role in our Boston Back Bay office (~3 days per week)




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner closely with senior leaders on organizational and People challenges, bringing strong judgment, perspective, and a willingness to constructively challenge and push thinking

 - Own and continuously improve core People practices across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, promotions, performance management, leaves, and offboarding

 - Advise and coach managers on performance, feedback, employee relations, organizational changes, promotions, and terminations

 - Navigate sensitive and complex employee matters with sound judgment, balancing employee experience, business needs, and risk

 - Help design and run company-wide performance review and promotion cycles, creating clear and scalable processes for managers and employees

 - Develop, document, and scale People policies, processes, and playbooks that support Maven as we continue to grow

 - Own and evolve our employee handbook, ensuring policies remain practical, compliant, and aligned with how we operate

 - Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations and proactively identify where our practices need to evolve as the company scales

 - Identify emerging People and organizational needs before they become problems, and take ownership of developing practical solutions

 - Partner cross-functionally to translate business needs into People programs, processes, and organizational solutions

 - Work alongside our People & Talent Operations Associate to create efficient, high-quality operational processes across the People function

 - Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve People workflows, systems, documentation, and employee experiences

 - Move quickly from problem to action, even when the path isn't fully defined, bringing in the right people and information along the way

 - Jump into whatever needs to be built or solved, from high-level organizational initiatives to the operational details required to make them successful




WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 8+ years of progressive HR, People Operations, People Business Partner, or related experience, ideally including meaningful experience within a venture-backed, high-growth technology company

 - You've experienced meaningful organizational growth and change firsthand, ideally within a Series A, B, or C environment, and understand what it takes to build People practices while a company is scaling quickly

 - You're a true HR/People generalist and builder, with hands-on experience across employee relations, performance management, terminations, promotions, onboarding/offboarding, HR policy, compliance, and People Operations

 - You've personally built or significantly improved People programs, policies, processes, or infrastructure rather than solely operating within established systems

 - You're a credible partner to senior leaders who can build trust quickly, offer a strong point of view, and respectfully challenge or push back when the business needs it

 - You have strong judgment and can navigate sensitive, ambiguous People situations without needing a playbook for every scenario

 - You're highly proactive and self-directed. You identify what needs to happen, create a path forward, and move with urgency without waiting for someone to tell you what to do

 - You're intellectually curious, learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions, and enjoy getting to the root of unfamiliar or complex problems

 - You're energized by growth and ownership and want an environment where there is still a lot to build, improve, and figure out

 - You're comfortable moving constantly between strategic and tactical work, advising an executive in one moment and digging into the underlying process, documentation, or employee issue in the next

 - You're personable, approachable, and able to build strong relationships across levels while also navigating challenging conversations with clarity and confidence

 - You bring a practical, business-minded approach to People and know how to create structure without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy

 - Most importantly, you're excited to help build the People foundation of a rapidly scaling startup and want your impact and scope to grow alongside the company




HOW YOU SHOW UP

 - We are customer champions. You put users at the center of your thinking, advocate for their needs, and design solutions that make their lives measurably better.

 - We are bold in action. You move with urgency and courage, unafraid to challenge convention and take smart risks in pursuit of meaningful outcomes.

 - We are data-driven and insight guided. You make thoughtful decisions grounded in evidence, combining data with intuition to guide strategy and execution.

 - We are stronger together. You bring others along, value diverse perspectives, and contribute to a culture of trust and shared ownership.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums covered for you, 80% for family

 - HSA and FSA plans available

 - Unlimited vacation and 100% paid parental leave

 - Free lunches, onsite gym, and commuter benefits for in-office employees

 - $1,000 home office stipend and $5,000/year for continuing education

 - Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful equity

 - ~120 people, built from zero in under three years — small enough that your work is visible, big enough to already be running at Dell- and Tripadvisor-scale



Maven AGI is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and is committed to fostering an environment where everyone feels included.

Join us in changing the face of enterprise customer support.

POSITION OVERVIEW

As Manager, Sales Development at Maven AGI, you will lead, coach, and develop a growing team of SDRs responsible for creating pipeline across our enterprise sales organization. Reporting to our Head of Sales Development, you'll be a hands-on frontline leader who is close to the work: coaching calls, improving messaging and prospecting, inspecting performance, developing reps, and creating the operating rhythm that helps the team consistently deliver.

We're looking for a true player-coach rather than a purely strategic leader. You'll help SDRs become stronger sellers, build repeatable habits, and progress in their careers, while partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to execute against Maven's broader go-to-market strategy.

This is an opportunity to join at an exciting stage of growth, with the SDR organization expanding alongside the business and significant opportunity to help shape how the team operates and scales.

*This role is based in our Boston, MA (Back Bay) office and is full-time in-office.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of SDRs, providing consistent feedback, mentorship, and hands-on support to improve individual and team performance

 - Establish strong day-to-day operating rhythms around prospecting, call coaching, pipeline creation, performance management, and accountability

 - Coach reps on messaging, discovery, objection handling, account research, personalization, and multi-channel prospecting

 - Build a high-performance culture grounded in curiosity, competitiveness, continuous learning, and shared accountability

 - Help SDRs develop the skills and business acumen necessary to grow into future closing and broader sales roles

 - Drive execution against team KPIs and pipeline goals, using data to identify trends, diagnose gaps, and improve performance

 - Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to translate Maven's ICP, account strategy, and go-to-market priorities into effective SDR execution

 - Help the team execute thoughtful, account-based prospecting into larger enterprise and strategic accounts

 - Continuously test and improve prospecting approaches, messaging, workflows, and team processes

 - Ensure strong CRM hygiene, lead and account management, and effective handoffs between SDRs and Account Executives

 - Leverage AI and modern sales technology to make the team more effective and efficient, while encouraging experimentation with new tools and workflows

 - Support onboarding, ramp, training, and ongoing enablement as the SDR organization continues to grow


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including meaningful experience leading, coaching, or managing SDR/BDR teams

 - You have a track record of developing early-career sales talent and helping reps improve performance and progress in their careers

 - You understand what great frontline sales execution looks like and are excited to stay close to the work rather than managing from a distance

 - You have experience prospecting into larger enterprise accounts and understand thoughtful, account-based selling motions

 - You are highly organized and comfortable creating structure, operating rhythms, and accountability in a fast-moving environment

 - You are metrics-oriented and know how to use data to diagnose performance, coach effectively, and make better decisions

 - You are fluent in modern sales technology and excited about using AI to improve how sales teams work. Experience with tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, LeadIQ, Nooks, Gong, Granola, or similar platforms is a plus

 - You bring curiosity, competitive drive, and a strong learning orientation, and you look for ways to continually improve yourself and the people around you

 - You thrive in an early-stage environment where processes are still evolving and you're expected to roll up your sleeves and help build

 - Previous experience as an Account Executive or in another closing role is strongly preferred, particularly if you've made the progression from SDR/BDR into closing and then into sales leadership
